exercises.instructionUz: Joyning joylashuvini tasvirlash uchun ushbu iboralarni ishlatamiz.
exercises.explanationUz:
JOYLAShUV IBORALARI:

  is situated/located IN the
    east/west/south-east OF ...
    = ...ning sharqida/g'arbida/
    janubi-sharqida joylashgan
  ON the north/south/south-west
    coast OF ...
    = ...ning shimoliy/janubiy/
    janubi-g'arbiy qirg'og'ida
  IN the heart/centre OF ...
    = ...ning markazida


⚠ 'IN' yoki 'ON'?

  IN the north OF = shimolida
    (ichkarida)
  ON the north COAST OF = shimoliy
    QIRG'OG'IDA
  ⚠ 'coast' bilan har doim 'on'!


⚠ 'SITUATED' = 'LOCATED':

  = joylashgan.
  ⚠ 'is situated' - passiv shakl.


⚠ YO'NALIShLAR:

  north = shimol; south = janub;
  east = sharq; west = g'arb;
  north-east = shimoli-sharq;
  south-west = janubi-g'arb.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Milan isn't situated in the
   south-east of Italy. It's in the
   north of Italy.'


XARITA (ITALIYa):
  Milan - shimol (shimoli-g'arb)
  Venice - shimoli-sharq
  Florence - markaz (shimoliy qism)
  Rome - g'arbiy qirg'oq, markaz
  Naples - janubi-g'arbiy qirg'oq


TO'G'RILANGAN GAPLAR:

  1 Milan isn't in the south-east.
    It's in the north of Italy.
  2 Florence isn't in the south.
    It's in the centre of Italy.
  3 Venice isn't on the west coast.
    It's on the north-east coast of
    Italy.
  4 Rome isn't in the north. It's in
    the centre of Italy, on the
    west coast.
  5 Naples isn't on the east coast.
    It's on the south-west coast of
    Italy.


⚠ ShAHAR NOMLARI:

  Milan = Milan; Venice = Venetsiya;
  Florence = Florensiya; Rome = Rim;
  Naples = Neapol.

tasks.en: The Alton Towers Hotel is set in the heart of Staffordshire's scenic countryside in the north-west of England. It is only minutes away from Britain's most magical theme park, Alton Towers.
tasks.uz: Alton Towers mehmonxonasi Angliyaning shimoli-g'arbidagi Staffordshirning go'zal qishloq manzarasi markazida joylashgan. U Britaniyaning eng sehrli mavzuli istirohat bog'i Alton Towers'dan bir necha daqiqa masofada.

tasks.en: Like the park, the hotel offers guests the chance to experience a delightful holiday full of fun and surprises.

tasks.en: The first thing you'll notice when you enter the hotel is the extraordinary reception desk, which is made of piles of antique luggage, and a flying machine which stretches up to the ceiling!

tasks.en: The hotel also offers an amazing range of themed rooms and suites. These include The Peter Rabbit Bedrooms, the Garden Rooms, the Explorer Room, the Cadbury's Chocolate Bedroom, the Coca-Cola Fizzy Factory Room, and the Arabian Nights Suite, which is possibly the most romantic hotel suite in the world.
tasks.uz: Mehmonxona ajoyib mavzuli xonalar va lyuks xonalar ham taklif qiladi. Bularga Peter Rabbit yotoqxonalari, Bog' xonalari, Sayyoh xonasi, Cadbury's Shokolad yotoqxonasi, Coca-Cola Gazli zavod xonasi va ehtimol dunyodagi eng romantik mehmonxona xonasi - Arab kechalari lyuks xonasi kiradi.

tasks.en: All the bedrooms and suites have a bathroom, tea- and coffee-making facilities, satellite TV and a baby-listening facility.

tasks.en: You'll never get bored at the Alton Towers Hotel, even during rainy or cold weather! After a thrilling day at the park, you can relax in the pool at the Pirate's Lagoon.

tasks.en: The Secret Garden Restaurant offers delicious dishes from around the world, while the hotel's two bars, the Dragon Bar and the Captain's Bar, are both ideal places to relax with a coffee or a cocktail in the evening.
tasks.uz: Secret Garden restorani dunyo bo'ylab mazali taomlarni taklif qiladi, mehmonxonaning ikki bari - Dragon Bar va Captain's Bar esa kechqurun qahva yoki kokteyl bilan dam olish uchun ideal joylar.

tasks.en: The Alton Towers Hotel is the ideal place for a fun family holiday at any time of year, but don't forget that the theme park is only open from mid-March to the end of October.
tasks.uz: Alton Towers mehmonxonasi yilning istalgan vaqtida qiziqarli oilaviy ta'til uchun ideal joy, lekin unutmang - mavzuli bog' faqat mart o'rtasidan oktyabr oxirigacha ochiq.

tasks.en: Looking for an exciting winter getaway? Then try the Ice Hotel in northern Sweden and spend a few days in a giant igloo.
tasks.uz: Hayajonli qishki sayohat qidiryapsizmi? Unda Shvetsiya shimolidagi Muz mehmonxonasini sinab ko'ring va ulkan igluda bir necha kun o'tkazing.
tasks.note: ⚠ 'getaway' = qisqa dam olish safari; 'igloo' = qor uy.

tasks.en: 2,000 tonnes of ice and 30,000 tonnes of snow are needed to build the Ice Hotel every year. When the thermometer hits 3 degrees below freezing, the building of the hotel starts.
tasks.uz: Har yili Muz mehmonxonasini qurish uchun 2000 tonna muz va 30000 tonna qor kerak. Termometr muzlashdan 3 daraja pastga tushganda mehmonxona qurilishi boshlanadi.

tasks.en: The hotel has rooms for over 100 guests, as well as an ice sauna, a cinema, the Ice Chapel and the world-famous Absolut Ice Bar.
tasks.uz: Mehmonxonada 100 dan ortiq mehmon uchun xonalar, shuningdek muz saunasi, kinoteatr, Muz ibodatxonasi va dunyoga mashhur Absolut Muz bari bor.

tasks.en: The temperature inside the hotel is minus 3 degrees Celsius, but that seems warm when you compare it to the temperature outside, which can fall below minus 30 degrees Celsius.
tasks.uz: Mehmonxona ichidagi harorat minus 3 daraja Selsiy, lekin tashqaridagi harorat bilan solishtirganda bu iliq tuyuladi - tashqarida minus 30 darajadan pastga tushishi mumkin.

tasks.en: Before bedtime, have a meal prepared by master chefs, then visit the Absolut Ice Bar, where you might just meet your favourite model or actor, or enjoy a crystal-clear view of the starry Arctic sky.
tasks.uz: Uyqudan oldin usta oshpazlar tayyorlagan ovqatni yeng, keyin Absolut Muz bariga boring - u yerda sevimli model yoki aktyoringizni uchratishingiz yoki yulduzli Arktika osmonining kristaldek tiniq manzarasidan bahramand bo'lishingiz mumkin.

tasks.en: When it's time for bed, don't worry about keeping warm. The Ice Hotel provides guests with warm sleeping bags to sleep in. Guests wake up to a hot drink, after which they can enjoy an early morning sauna and a tasty breakfast.
tasks.uz: Uxlash vaqti kelganda, isinish haqida tashvishlanmang. Muz mehmonxonasi mehmonlarga uxlash uchun iliq uxlash xaltalarini beradi. Mehmonlar issiq ichimlik bilan uyg'onadi, keyin erta tonggi sauna va mazali nonushtadan bahramand bo'lishlari mumkin.

tasks.en: The Arctic is the perfect place for outdoor activities such as dog-sledding, ice-fishing and skiing. If you haven't got skis, the staff at reception will provide you with everything you need.
tasks.uz: Arktika it chanasida yurish, muz ustida baliq ovlash va chang'i kabi ochiq havo mashg'ulotlari uchun mukammal joy. Agar chang'ingiz bo'lmasa, qabulxona xodimlari sizga kerak bo'lgan hamma narsani beradi.

tasks.en: A visit to the Ice Hotel is an unforgettable experience and the perfect way to liven up your winter. Don't miss this chance of a lifetime!
tasks.uz: Muz mehmonxonasiga tashrif - unutilmas tajriba va qishingizni jonlantirishning mukammal usuli. Bu hayotda bir marta keladigan imkonni qo'ldan boy bermang!

exercises.instructionEn: Study the examples, then say when we use who, where and which.
exercises.instructionUz: Misollarni o'rganing, keyin who, where va which ni qachon ishlatishimizni ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
NISBIY OLMOShLAR - IKKI GAPNI
BIRLAShTIRISh.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  WHO - ODAMLAR                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  I spoke to a policeman. HE was
  very helpful.
  → I spoke to a policeman WHO was
    very helpful.
  ⚠ 'who' = 'he/she/they' o'rnida.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  WHERE - JOYLAR                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  I went to Spain. I met my husband
  THERE.
  → I went to Spain WHERE I met my
    husband.
  ⚠ 'where' = 'there' o'rnida.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  WHICH - NARSALAR/HAYVONLAR      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  A CD player is a machine. IT
  plays music.
  → A CD player is a machine WHICH
    plays music.
  ⚠ 'which' = 'it' o'rnida.


⚠ 'THAT':

  'who' va 'which' o'rnida 'that'
  ham ishlatiladi (so'zlashuvda):
  'a machine THAT plays music'.


⚠ 'HELPFUL':

  = yordamchan, foydali.

tasks.uz: CD pleyer - bu mashina. U musiqa chaladi. → CD pleyer - musiqa chaladigan mashina.

  'A barman is someone WHO serves

MOSLASh:
  1 barman → c serve drinks
  2 porter → e carry luggage
  3 chef → a cook food
  4 maid → f clean rooms
  5 waiter → b serve meals
  6 receptionist → d welcome guests

  'someone' - birlik, fe'lga -S:

  chef = oshpaz /ʃef/

    tozalovchi)

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'They went to the Barbican
   Theatre, WHERE they saw Romeo
   and Juliet.'


⚠ Audio kerak, lekin mantiqan
aniq:

  1 Barbican Theatre → b Romeo and
    Juliet (teatr - spektakl)
  2 Trafalgar Square → a Nelson's
    Column (maydondagi ustun)
  3 National Gallery → d paintings
    (galereya - rasmlar)
  4 Savoy Hotel → e afternoon tea
    (mashhur mehmonxona choyi)
  5 Highbury Stadium → c football
    match (stadion)


⚠ LONDON JOYLARI:

  Barbican Theatre - teatr
  Trafalgar Square - markaziy
    maydon, Nelson ustuni bilan
  National Gallery - Milliy rasm
    galereyasi
  Savoy Hotel - mashhur hashamatli
    mehmonxona
  Highbury Stadium - Arsenal
    futbol klubining eski stadioni


⚠ 'AFTERNOON TEA':

  = tushdan keyingi choy (ingliz
  an'anasi - choy, sendvich, pirog).


⚠ 'TO ADMIRE':

  = zavqlanib tomosha qilmoq,
  hayratlanmoq.


⚠ 'A COLUMN':

  = ustun. /ˈkɒləm/ - 'n' o'qilmaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text in Ex. 4 again, then make notes under these headings. Use your notes to talk about the Alton Towers Hotel. • Name/Location/Why special • Description • What you can do there • Recommendation
exercises.instructionUz: 4-mashqdagi matnni yana o'qing, keyin ushbu sarlavhalar ostida qaydlar yozing. Qaydlaringizdan Alton Towers mehmonxonasi haqida gapirish uchun foydalaning. • Nomi/Joylashuvi/Nega alohida • Tavsif • U yerda nima qilish mumkin • Tavsiya
exercises.explanationUz:
QAYDLAR:

  NAME/LOCATION/WHY SPECIAL:
    Alton Towers Hotel;
    Staffordshire, NW England; next
    to theme park; magic never ends
  DESCRIPTION:
    reception desk of antique
    luggage; flying machine; themed
    rooms & suites; bathroom, TV,
    baby-listening
  WHAT YOU CAN DO:
    pool, Pirate Bill's Club,
    restaurant, two bars
  RECOMMENDATION:
    ideal for family holiday; book
    early


⚠ 'A RECOMMENDATION':

  = tavsiya.
  ⚠ 'to recommend' = tavsiya
  qilmoq.


⚠ 'LOCATION':

  = joylashuv.

tasks.en: The hotel has an extraordinary reception desk made of antique luggage and a flying machine. It has themed rooms and suites, and every room has a bathroom, satellite TV and a baby-listening facility.
tasks.uz: Mehmonxonada eski jomadonlardan yasalgan g'ayrioddiy qabulxona stoli va uchuvchi mashina bor. Unda mavzuli xonalar va lyuks xonalar bor, har xonada hammom, sun'iy yo'ldosh TV va chaqaloqni eshitish qurilmasi bor.

tasks.en: At the hotel you can relax in the pool, kids can join Pirate Bill's Club, and you can eat at the Secret Garden Restaurant or have a drink in one of the two bars.
tasks.uz: Mehmonxonada basseynda dam olish mumkin, bolalar Pirate Bill klubiga qo'shilishi mumkin, Secret Garden restoranida ovqatlanish yoki ikki bardan birida ichimlik ichish mumkin.

tasks.en: I think it's an ideal place for a family holiday. You should book early because it's very popular.
tasks.uz: Menimcha, bu oilaviy ta'til uchun ideal joy. Erta bron qilishingiz kerak, chunki u juda mashhur.

tasks.en: The hotel has rooms for over 100 guests, an ice sauna, a cinema, the Ice Chapel and the famous Absolut Ice Bar. The temperature inside is minus 3 degrees.

tasks.en: Inside, you can have a meal prepared by master chefs, visit the Ice Bar and sleep in a warm sleeping bag. In the morning you can have a sauna and breakfast.
tasks.uz: Ichkarida usta oshpazlar tayyorlagan ovqatni yeyish, Muz bariga borish va iliq uxlash xaltasida uxlash mumkin. Ertalab sauna va nonushta qilish mumkin.

tasks.en: Outside, you can go dog-sledding, ice-fishing and skiing. The staff will give you everything you need.

tasks.uz: Menimcha, Muz mehmonxonasiga tashrif - unutilmas tajriba. Bu imkonni qo'ldan boy bermasligingiz kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the pictures in the Photo File section to help you write two postcards. Write where you are and where you are staying, what the weather/food is like and your recommendation. Use the postcards in Ex. 10 as models.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki otkritka yozishga yordam berish uchun Photo File bo'limidagi suratlardan foydalaning. Qayerdaligingiz va qayerda turganingiz, ob-havo/ovqat qanday ekani va tavsiyangizni yozing. 10-mashqdagi otkritkalardan namuna sifatida foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
OTKRITKA REJASI:

  1 Dear ...,
  2 We're having a ... time here
    in ... (QAYERDA)
  3 We're staying in/at ...
    (QAYERDA TURIBMIZ)
  4 The weather is ... / The food
    is ... (OB-HAVO/OVQAT)
  5 You must visit ... / It's worth
    a visit! (TAVSIYa)
  6 Love, / Best wishes, + ism

  ⚠ Photo File - kitob oxirida
  (suratlar bo'limi).


⚠ 'WHAT IS THE WEATHER LIKE?':

  = ob-havo qanday?
  ⚠ 'like' bu yerda 'yoqmoq' EMAS!
